issues.problem: Every shingle joint still renders as a hard dark 1 px line, so the band reads as planks or a venetian blind (v4, v8 left, v9, q16 top left). In the photos the joints are soft, low-contrast steps. The riser colour change had almost no effect, because the step face is lit at grazing incidence.
issues.evidence: v8 col 150: 145-147 on 209-210 (0.69x). v4 row 300: 128/141 on 209. w7a gave 150 on 225-235, so the change barely moved it. y_47301 top left is about 200 on 235 (0.85x), and the c26 band steps are faint.
issues.fix: 08_bins.js BINMAT.riser: make it self-lit like the band, { c: '#d2d3d4', r: 0.7, l: LAYER.plastic, e: 0.14 }. Or, in the step-face gBox at line 207, override the normals to the band normal (0,-1,0 in the band frame) so the riser shades like the band. Target 0.85-0.9x the band.

issues.problem: The seams read as hard dark hairlines with a light partner line. In c120 the joints show as soft light beads/ridges with a faint shadow (outboard, right crop) or as chunky rail joints (centre bin, left crop), not as dark cuts.

issues.problem: After the e5266cc tweak the speaker reads as a flat grey bar sunk in the vault. c120's vault fitting reads as a same-tone rounded rectangle drawn mostly by a thin shadow outline and a dark crescent along one long edge. In v11/v2, which predate the tweak, the bar is darker still.
